消息传得有多快，王建新不知道，但王建新接到了边防团张团长的电话。

电话是打到学生工作办公室的，陈主任接的，说了几句，就把话筒递给王建新，笑眯眯地说：“你们团长。”

王建新接过话筒，那边传来张团长熟悉的声音，大嗓门，隔着电话都能听出来。“小王啊，好样的！我在报纸上看到你了，断指再植，了不起！咱们团出了你这么个人才，我脸上有光！”

王建新握着话筒，心里热乎乎的：“首长，您过奖了。”

“过什么奖？我说的是实话。”张团长在电话那头哈哈大笑，“好好学，学好了回来给咱们团的人看病。行了，不说了，在那好好学，别丢咱们团的脸。”

电话挂了。王建新把话筒放下，嘴角带着笑。

当天晚上便是王建新和黑市老大约定的交货时间。

晚上等大家睡着后，王建新照例点了他们的昏睡穴。然后先进了空间，大毛它们五个围上来，摇着尾巴，他摸了摸大毛的头，又给小狐狸倒了盆牛奶。然后挤了牛奶——奶牛在空间里养得膘肥体壮，每天挤出来的奶多得很，他昨天又做了一些奶制品存着。忙完了，换了一身不显眼的旧衣服，灰不溜秋的，蒙上脸，只露出眼睛。

利用空间瞬移，他直接来到了黑市上次那个二进四合院门口。

夜风凉飕飕的，胡同里黑漆漆的，没有路灯。他敲了敲门。

门开了一条缝，里面探出一个光溜溜的脑袋，一脸横肉，眼睛眯成一条缝。他上下打量着王建新，刚要发问，王建新先开了口：“和你们老大约好的，今天来取货。”说着拍了拍胸前的帆布包，里面传来金条碰撞的声音——叮叮当当，清脆悦耳。

光头汉子把门开大了一点，探出头左右瞅了瞅，胡同里空荡荡的，没人。他侧身让王建新进来，门关上了。

王建新进来后照直往二进四合院走，一路上用神识扫过——前院有五个人，有的在屋里喝酒，有的在门口抽烟，都是膀大腰圆的汉子。后院他们老大那屋还是三个人，跟上次一样。

他来到后院堂屋门口，门开着，灯光从里面透出来。王建新直接走了进去，开口问道：“我要的中药种子凑齐了吗？”

那个老大坐在八仙桌后面，正在喝茶。他愣了一下，大概没想到王建新来得这么准时，然后便堆起笑脸：“小兄弟你来了，请坐。”

王建新走到八仙桌对面，在椅子上坐下。

上次那个算账的中年男人坐在旁边，手里拿着账本和算盘。他推了推眼镜，开口了：“小兄弟，你要的种子一共凑够了八十六种，每种最少一斤，多的两斤。你全能吃下吗？这些东西可是不少钱呢。”

王建新没吱声，点了点头。

中年男人翻开账本，开始念。

“板蓝根、白芷、牛膝、紫苏、薄荷等四十二种，各两斤，种子两块钱一斤，一共一百六十八元。”

这价格比国营商店贵了十倍。王建新还是没吱声，点了点头。

“黄芩、柴胡、防风、桔梗、丹参等二十八种，每种也是各二斤，十二元一斤，共计六百七十二元。”

王建新心里盘算了一下，比国营商店贵了十五倍。他还是没吱声，又点了点头。

“麻黄、甘草、人参籽、黄连、远志、杜仲等十六种——”中年男人顿了顿，抬起头看了王建新一眼，“你应该也知道，这可是严控禁售的。每种籽搞来一斤，每斤六十元，共计九百六十元。”

这个加价可就狠了。外面买不到，他们有门路搞到，要多少钱还不是他们说了算？算下来，比正常价格贵了差不多两百倍。

中年男人拿起桌上的算盘，噼里啪啦打了一通，然后抬起头：“一共是一千八百元。你上次的金条在咱们这，可是不值七八百的，最多给你算四百块钱一根。”

好嘛，不是一般的黑。

王建新一直想来个黑吃黑不对应该是白吃黑——把这些人全收拾了，东西全拿走，一分钱不花。可是人家正常交易，你不能直接吃吧？凡事要讲个道理。人家帮你搞到了种子，你把人杀了，把东西抢了，那不成了土匪了？

他想了想，说道：“那把上次那根金条还我吧，我给你们现金，现金我也带了。”

中年男人愣了一下，没想到王建新是这个回答。他看了看旁边那个恶狠狠的汉子，又看了看老大。

那个恶狠狠的汉子坐在王建新侧面，一直没说话，手里转着两个核桃，转得咔咔响。听到王建新这话，他猛地一拍桌子，核桃差点飞出去。

Wang Jianxin didn't know how fast the news spread, but Wang Jianxin received a call from Zhang, the head of the border defense regiment.

The call was made to the student affairs office. Director Chen answered it, said a few words, handed the phone to Wang Jianxin, and said with a smile: "Your team leader."

Wang Jianxin took the phone, and the familiar voice of Captain Zhang came over there. The voice was so loud that he could hear it through the phone."Xiao Wang, great job! I saw you in the newspaper. Your severed finger was replanted. It's amazing! We have a talent like you in our team. I feel so proud!"

Wang Jianxin held the microphone and said warmly: "Chief, you have thanked me."

"What award? I told the truth." Captain Zhang laughed loudly on the other end of the phone, "Study hard, and come back to treat the people in our group after you have learned it. Okay, let's not talk anymore, study hard there, and don't embarrass our group."

The phone was hung up.Wang Jianxin put down the microphone with a smile on his face.

That evening was the delivery time agreed upon by Wang Jianxin and the black market boss.

At night, after everyone fell asleep, Wang Jianxin clicked on their sleep acupoints as usual.Then he entered the space first, and Da Mao and the other five gathered around him, wagging their tails. He touched Da Mao's head, and poured a basin of milk for the little fox.Then he milked the cows - the cows grew fat and strong in the space, and squeezed out a lot of milk every day. He made some dairy products yesterday and saved them.After finishing my work, I changed into a pair of inconspicuous old clothes, gray and gray, and covered my face, leaving only my eyes exposed.

Using spatial teleportation, he came directly to the door of the second-entry courtyard in the black market.

The night breeze was chilly, and the alley was dark with no street lights.He knocked on the door.

The door opened a crack, and a bare head popped out, with a sinewy face and narrowed eyes.He looked Wang Jianxin up and down, and when he was about to ask a question, Wang Jianxin spoke first: "I made an appointment with your boss, and I will come to pick up the goods today." As he spoke, he patted the canvas bag on his chest, and the sound of gold bars colliding came from inside - jingling, crisp and sweet.

The bald man opened the door a little wider, poked his head out and looked around. There was no one in the alley.He turned sideways to let Wang Jianxin in and closed the door.

After Wang Jianxin came in, he walked straight to the second courtyard, scanning with his spiritual consciousness along the way - there were five people in the front yard, some were drinking in the house, and some were smoking at the door. They were all big-bodied and round-waisted men.There are still three people in their boss's room in the backyard, just like last time.

He came to the door of the main room in the backyard. The door was open and the light came from inside.Wang Jianxin walked directly in and asked, "Have you gathered the Chinese medicine seeds I want?"

The boss was sitting behind the Eight Immortals table, drinking tea.He was stunned for a moment, probably not expecting Wang Jianxin to arrive so punctually, then he put on a smile and said: "You are here, little brother, please sit down."

Wang Jianxin walked to the opposite side of the Eight Immortals table and sat down on the chair.

The middle-aged man who settled the accounts last time was sitting next to him, holding a ledger and an abacus in his hands.He pushed up his glasses and spoke: "Little brother, there are eighty-six kinds of seeds in total. Each kind is at least one kilogram, and more than two kilograms. Can you eat them all? These things cost a lot of money."

Wang Jianxin said nothing and nodded.

The middle-aged man opened the account book and began to read.

"Forty-two kinds of isatis root, angelica root, achyranthes root, perilla, mint, etc., two kilograms each. The seeds cost two yuan per kilogram, a total of one hundred and sixty-eight yuan."

The price is ten times more expensive than state-owned stores.Wang Jianxin remained silent and nodded.

"Skullcap, Bupleurum, Fangfeng, Platycodon, Salvia miltiorrhiza and other twenty-eight kinds, each is two pounds each, twelve yuan per pound, a total of six hundred and seventy-two yuan."

Wang Jianxin calculated it in his mind and found that it was fifteen times more expensive than the state-owned store.He still said nothing and nodded again.

"Sixteen kinds of ephedra, licorice, ginseng seeds, coptis, Polygala, Eucommia ulmoides, etc." The middle-aged man paused, raised his head and glanced at Wang Jianxin, "You should also know that this is strictly prohibited from sale. One kilogram of each seed costs 60 yuan per kilogram, totaling 960 yuan."

This price increase is quite severe.You can’t buy it outside, but they have a way to get it, but it’s not up to them to decide how much it will cost?After all, it is almost two hundred times more expensive than the normal price.

The middle-aged man picked up the abacus on the table, made a few clicks, and then raised his head: "The total is 1,800 yuan. The gold bars you had last time were with us, but they were not worth 700 or 800 yuan. I will give you 400 yuan a bar at most."

Well, it's not just black.

Wang Jianxin has always wanted to do something black and take advantage of others. Instead of taking advantage of others, he should clean up all these people and take away all their belongings without spending a penny.But it’s a normal transaction, so you can’t eat it directly, right?There must be a reason for everything.If someone helped you get the seeds, and you killed them and robbed the things, wouldn't that make you a bandit?

He thought for a moment and said, "Give me back the gold bar from last time. I'll give you the cash. I also brought the cash."

The middle-aged man was stunned for a moment, but he didn't expect Wang Jianxin's answer.He looked at the vicious man next to him, and then at the boss.

The vicious man sat next to Wang Jianxin and remained silent while spinning two walnuts in his hand, making a clicking sound.When he heard Wang Jianxin's words, he slammed the table so hard that the walnuts almost flew out.
